I'm not able to diagnose anyone, and only a qualified mental health professional can determine whether someone has schizophrenia or another condition. If you're noticing changes in your husband's thinking, behavior, or perception—such as confusion, withdrawal, unusual beliefs, or hearing things that aren't there—those could be worth discussing with a professional.

I'd encourage you to talk with your husband about your concerns, if it feels safe to do so, and suggest he speak with a doctor or mental health specialist. If he's in distress or you're worried about his safety, reaching out to a healthcare provider or a local mental health helpline can be a good next step. Taking care of your own well-being matters too, so please seek support for yourself if you need it.
